q: How does CognitiveBotics support inclusive education in schools?
a: CognitiveBotics helps schools deliver inclusive education by connecting teachers, special educators, therapists and families on one platform. Schools can personalise learning, track progress and support neurodivergent learners more consistently.

q: Is CognitiveBotics only designed for autistic learners?
a: CognitiveBotics supports autistic and neurodivergent learners through personalised learning plans and developmental goals. Schools can tailor support to each child's individual strengths and needs.

q: Does CognitiveBotics replace special educators or school counsellors?
a: No, CognitiveBotics complements the work of special educators and school counsellors by providing tools for planning, collaboration and progress tracking, allowing them to focus more on supporting learners.

CognitiveBotics gives teachers personalised learning plans, classroom resources and developmental insights to better support neurodivergent learners. It also strengthens collaboration with families and specialists.

q: Does CognitiveBotics support Individualised Education Plans (IEPs)?
a: Yes, CognitiveBotics enables schools to create, manage and monitor Individualised Education Plans (IEPs); making it easier to personalise learning and track developmental progress.

q: Does CognitiveBotics align with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020?
a: Yes, CognitiveBotics supports the inclusive education and personalised learning goals of NEP 2020 and its modules are structured with reference to NCF 2023. We help schools integrate developmental support within their existing educational framework and enable collaboration between educators, specialists and families to extend support beyond the classroom.

q: How are parents involved in CognitiveBotics?
a: Parents receive guided home activities, learning resources and regular progress updates through CognitiveBotics. This helps extend learning beyond the classroom and reinforces developmental goals at home.

CognitiveBotics Bloom is a tailored implementation programme that combines the CognitiveBotics platform with specialist guidance, teacher training and ongoing school support. It helps schools build and sustain inclusive education programmes with confidence.

q: Can CognitiveBotics be implemented in any school?
a: Yes, CognitiveBotics is designed for early years and primary-age learners aged 2- 7 and can be implemented across mainstream, inclusive and special schools that serve this age group. The platform and Bloom implementation programme are tailored to each school’s resources, student needs and inclusion goals.
